$comment: The provenance catalog of the models release (docs/MODELS_NOTICE.md, #942): every asset the release hosts, grouped into the artifacts they form (an ONNX graph with its `.onnx.data` external-weights sidecar is one artifact), with the upstream repository and revision the bytes come from, how they were produced (export | quantization | repack | rehost | build), the tool that did it and the SPDX licence — and, per artifact, `lineage` (#955): the upstream model card, the published records of how the weights were trained (reports, papers, datasets), for a re-hosted file how its producer made it (`upstream_conversion`), and `unavailable`, what no public record exists for. scripts/ci/models_manifest.sh joins it with the release's digests into the digest-bound `models.json` asset (plus `execution`, the publish run's own record, export_record.json) and refuses a release asset this file does not cover; scripts/install/export_*.py pin their upstream revision from it; publish-models.yml fetches the re-hosted files at the revisions recorded here.

artifacts.name: PDFium shared library (bblanchon/pdfium-binaries build, linux-x64)
artifacts.note: Not a model: Google's PDFium (BSD-3-Clause) as built and released by bblanchon/pdfium-binaries, re-hosted unmodified for docling-pdf's opt-in `pdfium` feature and its oracle tests; the default pipeline renders in pure Rust. The build's own LICENSE and the third-party notices of its dependencies ship inside the upstream tarball (`LICENSE`, `licenses/`) — LICENSE-pdfium-binaries.txt is that LICENSE.

upstream_conversion.by: bblanchon/pdfium-binaries — builds PDFium from Chromium's source at the tagged revision in its GitHub Actions workflow
upstream_conversion.note: the release page lists the assets and the pdfium/chromium revision; the workflow run that built the tag is not retained by GitHub beyond its log retention

unavailable: the build run itself (logs) — the release's assets and the tarball's VERSION are the durable record

artifacts.name: docling-parse page-renderer plugin (development oracle)
artifacts.note: Not a model: docling-parse's Blend2D renderer compiled as a dlopen-able shim (#478), one tarball per platform (lib/ + pdf_resources/). Only the conformance scripts load it (DOCLING_RS_RENDERER=docling-parse).

unavailable: an upstream SBOM or attestation — Microsoft publishes none for ONNX Runtime; the tarball's GIT_COMMIT_ID and BUILD_INFO (#954; a tarball built before them carries VERSION and LICENSE only) record the commit, the library's sha256, the toolchain and the workflow run, the workflow file at the recorded commit the recipe
